But just found one about 5 minutes ago thanks to users on Microsoft help (as opposed to microsoft people) and managed to finally re-kickstart the fuckin PIN dialogues at both ends and bamf ive now got my mouse phones and ps4 controller connected again - heres what got it going

services.msc

Find 'Bluetooth Support Service'

Right Click and stop the service.

Right click and hit 'properties'

Set Startup type to 'Manual' if it isnt. (I had done this before and it didnt seem to do much but the next step was new)

Click the Log On tab

Click 'Browse' next to 'This Account'

Click 'Advanced'

Click 'Find Now' and double click LOCAL SERVICE. It will then take you back to the 'Select User' dialogue, where you can just hit 'OK'

In the instructions i read, it told me to clear the 'Password and Confirm Password' boxes but the system wouldnt let me. Didnt matter, it worked anyway.

Close that dialogue and return to the Services dialogue.

Restart 'Bluetooth Support Service'

Then

Go to the bluetooth menu in the task bar and select 'Send a File' - Choose the device you want to send a file to, and fuckin bamf suddenly youre greeted with bluetooth pins left right and center, and game controllers fully functional again.

Peace out
